v.2: by the ones who drive [the clouds] vigorously,
v.3: by the ones who recite the reminder:
v.4: indeed your God is certainly One,
v.5: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Lord of the easts.
v.6: Indeed We have adorned the lowest heaven with the finery of the stars,
v.7: and to guard from any froward devil.
v.8: They do not eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite—they are shot at from every side,
v.9: to drive them away, and there is a perpetual punishment for them—
v.10: except any who snatches a snatch, whereat a piercing flame pursues him.
v.11: Ask them, is their creation more prodigious or [that of other creatures] that We have created? Indeed, We created them from a viscous clay.
v.12: Indeed you wonder, while they engage in ridicule,
v.13: and [even] when admonished do not take admonition,
v.14: and when they see a sign they make it an object of ridicule,
v.15: and say, ‘This is nothing but plain magic!’
v.16: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?
v.18: Say, ‘Yes! And you will be utterly humble.’
v.19: It will be only a single shout and, behold, they will look on,
v.20: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Retribution!’
v.21: ‘This is the Day of Judgement that you used to deny!’
v.22: ‘Muster the wrongdoers and their mates and what they used to worship
v.23: besides Allah, and show them the way to hell!
v.24: [But first] stop them! For they must be questioned.’
v.25: ‘Why is it that you do not support one another [today]?’
v.27: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.
v.28: They will say, ‘Indeed you used to accost us peremptorily.’
v.29: They will answer, ‘No, you [yourselves] had no faith.
v.30: We had no authority over you. No, you [yourselves] were a rebellious lot.
v.31: So our Lord’s word became due against us that we shall indeed taste [the punishment].
v.32: So we perverted you, for we were perverse [ourselves].’
v.33: So, that day they will share the punishment.
v.34: Indeed, that is how We deal with the guilty.
v.35: Indeed, it was they who, when they were told, ‘There is no god except Allah,’ used to be disdainful,
v.36: and [they would] say, ‘Shall we abandon our gods for a crazy poet?’
v.37: Indeed, he has brought [them] the truth, and confirmed the [earlier] apostles.
v.38: Indeed you will taste the painful punishment,
v.39: and you will be requited only for what you used to do
v.41: For such there is a known provision
v.42: —fruits—and they will be held in honour,
v.45: served around with a cup, from a clear fountain,
v.47: wherein there will be neither headache nor will it cause them stupefaction,
v.48: and with them will be maidens, of restrained glances with big [beautiful] eyes,
v.49: as if they were hidden ostrich eggs.
v.50: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.
v.51: One of them will say, ‘Indeed I had a companion
v.52: who used to say, ‘‘Are you really among those who affirm
v.53: that when we have died and become dust and bones, we shall be brought to retribution?’’ ’
v.54: He will say, ‘Will you have a look?’
v.55: Then he will take a look and sight him in the middle of hell.
v.56: He will say, ‘By Allah, you had almost ruined me!
v.57: Had it not been for my Lord’s blessing, I too would have been among those mustered [in hell]!’
v.58: ‘Is it [true] that we shall not die [anymore],
v.59: aside from our earlier death, and that we shall not be punished?
v.60: This is indeed the supreme triumph!’
v.61: Let all workers work for the like of this!
v.62: Is this a better reception, or the Zaqqum tree?
v.63: Indeed We have made it a punishment for the wrongdoers.
v.64: It is a tree that rises from the depths of hell.
v.65: Its spathes are as if they were devils’ heads.
v.66: They will eat from it and gorge with it their bellies.
v.67: On top of that they will take a solution of scalding water.
v.68: Then their retreat will be toward hell.
v.69: They had found their fathers astray,
v.70: yet they press onwards in their footsteps.
v.71: Most of the former peoples went astray before them,
v.72: and We had certainly sent warners among them.
v.73: So observe how was the fate of those who were warned
v.75: Certainly Noah called out to Us, and how well did We respond!
v.76: We delivered him and his family from their great distress,
v.77: and made his descendants the survivors,
v.78: and left for him a good name among posterity:
v.80: Thus do We reward the virtuous.
v.81: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.
v.83: Indeed Abraham was among his followers,
v.84: when he came to his Lord with a sound heart [untainted by sin].
v.85: When he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping?
v.86: Is it a lie, gods other than Allah, that you desire?
v.87: Then what is your idea about the Lord of all the worlds?’
v.88: Then he made an observation of the stars
v.90: So they went away leaving him behind.
v.91: Then he stole away to their gods and said, ‘Will you not eat?
v.93: Then he attacked them, striking forcefully.
v.95: He said, ‘Do you worship what you have yourselves carved,
v.96: when Allah has created you and whatever you make?’
v.97: They said, ‘Build a structure for him and cast him into a huge fire.’
v.98: So they sought to outwit him, but We made them the lowermost.
v.99: He said, ‘Indeed I am going toward my Lord, who will guide me.’
v.100: ‘My Lord! Give me [an heir], one of the righteous.’
v.101: So We gave him the good news of a forbearing son.
v.102: When he was old enough to assist in his endeavour, he said, ‘My son! I see in dreams that I am sacrificing you. See what you think.’ He said, ‘Father! Do whatever you have been commanded. If Allah wishes, you will find me to be patient.’
v.103: So when they had both surrendered [to Allah’s will], and he had laid him down on his forehead,
v.104: We called out to him, ‘O Abraham!
v.105: You have indeed fulfilled your vision! Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous!
v.106: This was indeed a manifest test.’
v.107: Then We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
v.108: and left for him a good name in posterity:
v.110: Thus do We reward the virtuous.
v.111: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.
v.112: And We gave him the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.
v.113: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants [some] are virtuous, and [some] who manifestly wrong themselves.
v.114: Certainly We favoured Moses and Aaron,
v.115: and delivered them and their people from their great distress,
v.116: and We helped them so that they became the victors.
v.117: We gave them the illuminating scripture
v.118: and guided them to the straight path,
v.119: and left for them a good name in posterity.
v.121: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.
v.122: They are indeed among Our faithful servants.
v.123: Indeed Ilyas was one of the apostles.
v.124: When he said to his people, ‘Will you not be Godwary?
v.125: Do you invoke Baal and abandon the best of creators,
v.126: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?,’
v.127: they impugned him. So they will indeed be mustered [in hell]
v.129: We left for him a good name in posterity.
v.131: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.
v.132: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.
v.133: Indeed Lot was one of the apostles.
v.134: When We delivered him and all his family,
v.135: excepting an old woman among those who remained behind,
v.137: Indeed you pass by them at dawn
v.138: and at night. Do you not exercise your reason?
v.139: Indeed Jonah was one of the apostles.
v.140: When he absconded toward the laden ship,
v.141: he drew lots with them and was the one to be condemned [as one to be thrown overboard].
v.142: Then the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy.
v.143: Had he not been one of those who celebrate Allah’s glory,
v.144: he would have surely remained in its belly till the day they will be resurrected.
v.145: Then We cast him on a bare shore, and he was sick.
v.146: So We made a gourd plant grow above him.
v.147: We sent him to a [community of] hundred thousand or more,
v.148: and they believed [in him]. So We provided for them for a while.
v.149: Ask them, are daughters to be for your Lord while sons are to be for them?
v.150: Did We create the angels females while they were present?
v.151: Be aware that it is out of their mendacity that they say,
v.152: ‘Allah has begotten [offsprings],’ and they indeed speak a falsehood.
v.153: Has He preferred daughters to sons?
v.154: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
v.155: Will you not then take admonition?
v.156: Do you have a manifest authority?
v.157: Then produce your scripture, should you be truthful.
v.158: And they have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn, while the jinn certainly know that they will be presented [before Him].
v.159: Clear is Allah of whatever they allege [about Him]
v.161: Indeed you and what you worship
v.163: except someone who is bound for hell.
v.164: ‘There is none among us but has a known place.
v.165: It is we who are the ranged ones.
v.166: It is we who celebrate Allah’s glory.’
v.168: ‘Had we possessed a Reminder from our predecessors,
v.169: we would have surely been Allah’s exclusive servants.’
v.170: But they disbelieved it [when it came to them]. Soon they will know!
v.171: Certainly Our decree has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the apostles,
v.172: that they will indeed receive [Allah’s] help,
v.173: and indeed Our hosts will be the victors.
v.174: So leave them alone for a while,
v.175: and watch them; soon they will see [the truth of the matter]!
v.176: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
v.177: But when it descends in their courtyard it will be a dismal dawn for those who had been warned.
v.178: So leave them alone for a while,
v.179: and watch; soon they will see!
v.180: Clear is your Lord, the Lord of Might, of whatever they allege [concerning Him].
v.182: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
